result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide residential street bordering a park, with a sidewalk present only on the residential side. The lack of marked crosswalks, traffic control devices, and curb extensions at the intersection creates significant exposure for pedestrians crossing the roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected between the park and housing.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the residential side of the street can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt can create tripping hazards or cause vehicles to swerve unexpectedly.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential and park-adjacent zone.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. The wide expanse of asphalt and lack of clear pedestrian priority create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility crosswalk and pedestrian signals connecting a residential area to a large park. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing may create visibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side of the image may block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Discontinuous sidewalk on park side
hazards.description: The paved area on the right corner is small and does not clearly connect to a continuous paved path into the park.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side corner near the signal pole

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide concrete sidewalk and a marked crosswalk adjacent to a park. Safety is compromised by faded pavement markings, a lack of tactile warnings on the curb ramp, and signage that restricts crossing at certain points of the intersection.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The white lines defining the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image across the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Tactile Paving
hazards.description: The curb ramp lacks truncated domes, making it difficult for visually impaired pedestrians to identify the transition to the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground at the corner of the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace the faded parallel lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility for motorists.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces (truncated domes) on the existing curb ramp to meet accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated street lighting at the crossing to improve nighttime visibility and safety for pedestrians.
